koma.support_effect: Jotaro strikes a cool pose while Star Platinum charges forward, fist raised. If he catches someone, he charges a tiny amount forward with them, and then punches them with his other fist. Damage: 24 to Power Characters, 36 to Knowledge characters and 24 to Laughter characters. Star Platinum holds the target briefly, allowing any follow-up attack to hit without knocking the opponent down.
koma.quote: Jotaro strikes a cool pose while Star Platinum charges forward, fist raised. If he catches someone, he charges a tiny amount forward with them, and then punches them with his other fist. ... Damage: 24 to Power Characters, 36 to Knowledge characters and 24 to Laughter characters. ... Also, as Star Platinum holds the target, there's a small time frame where you can launch ANY attack and the enemy will not be knocked down.

combos: Hotkey Terryman to L or R and use Jotaro 4 koma. As soon as you press X, press the hotkey. Star Platinum will hold the enemy, and in that brief second, Terryman will nail the enemy, and then Star Platinum will sock him with a punch. Does around 80 damage on average.

Terryman can also be used at the end of 5 koma or 6 koma's Special A, activated at the end of the attack, so Terryman brings the enemy back down with his knee. Deals anywhere between 70-90 damage, and leaves the enemy wide open for another attack.

Trap the opponent with Jotaro's Y attack (or 5/6 koma Special A for more damage at the cost of an extra SP bar), then use 3 koma Okita as soon as the attack begins; the opponent gets trapped by Jotaro's barrage and then nailed by the beetle's smash as the hits finish. Highest recorded was 134 damage.
It is possible to catch an opponent hit by 3 koma Takeshi Yamamoto's slash circle with 4 koma Jotaro's Special A while they are in the air right after being hit, or catch them with a Y barrage.
Rouji (2 koma) can halt a charging opponent or drain an SP bar from a spammer; trap the opponent in a Y attack to guarantee a hit, or stop them and launch off the edge with a forward Y.
Combining 4 koma's Special A with 3 koma Gotenks or 3 koma Zoro hotkeyed and triggered right after pressing X can usually rack up 115 damage.
